svg.text: All listed actions use your existing bindings. Context determines what the game does.
Rear: L4 / L5 on the left · R4 / R5 on the right
Base = no modifier · L4 = hold L4 · L5 = weapon selection · Hold ≠ a separate Steam Long Press

g.text: Combat: Interact with scope / hold breath while ADS
Left Shift is toggled by L3; press again to release it.
Combat: Heavy right melee attack / underarm throw (Hold)
Tools: Tool secondary action / inject medical pen into another player
L4 · down · Press → Left Alt + H
L4 · Long press → O (custom Star Citizen bind)
Base · Touch enabled → Gyro To Mouse
Combat: Heavy left melee attack / overarm throw (Hold)
Combat: Block melee attacks (Hold LT + RT)
Requires both mouse buttons held together.
Interaction: Zoom in in interaction mode
Interaction: Zoom out in interaction mode
L4 · ↑ · Scroll → Left Alt + Mouse Wheel Up
L4 · ↓ · Scroll → Left Alt + Mouse Wheel Down
Movement: Climb ledge / activate jump thrusters (Hold)
Base · Press → Hold Action Set Layer

svg.text: Reference: Alpha 4.10.2 defaults + custom bindings · Check notes for toggled or delayed inputs.
